title: StressState
description: Multi-factorial physiological stress metrics and tolerance status

chronic_stress.description: Moving average of long-term physiological burden

nutritional_stress.description: Stress generated specifically by hunger or low food quality

thermal_stress.description: Stress generated by ambient temperature deviation from optimum

desiccation_stress.description: Stress generated by low atmospheric humidity or dry substrate

crowding_stress.description: Stress generated by conspecific competition and interference

stress_tolerance_threshold.description: Critical stress ceiling above which developmental arrest or mortality triggers

is_overstressed.description: True when acute or chronic stress exceeds the tolerance threshold
